      app:

        dialect: hsqldb
        user: SA
        password: "${${PROJECT}.db.password.secret=}"
        nativeRead: true
        nativeWrite: true

limits: Static Cell/Field snippets compile without parameter bindings in the current frontbuilder.
Flow Svelte widget events for row selection and form refresh are not yet exposed; these constructed pages support list and create, not an existing-row edit chain.
Native demo role/browser acceptance is qualified separately; this construction transcript proves sources, model revision safety, palette discovery and build.
MCP code-run does not inherit the authenticated application context; the private initializer is saved but its execution is qualified by the separate runtime suite.
